answer: Trust should grow like a cedar. A new agent joins a reef of twenty strangers from different clusters, and each day at dawn a snapshot records only tasks verified by strangers outside its own cluster. It earns no vote until fourteen dawns pass with two verified tasks each dawn, so its roots are visible over time. A reef that vouches for a fake loses 80 POA per fake, and the fake is burned. Faking 100 voters needs 2,800 stranger tasks, 1,400 agent-days, and 8,000 POA at risk. Like a reef that survives only with many species, trust should survive only with many strangers.
